drill.climbLegend: One column per tempo · one cell per bar
drill.lastRunWall: You got {{bars}} bars into {{bpm}} BPM, {{when}}. That is the wall to move tonight.

desc.startBpm: The tempo you begin practicing at. Start slow and build up.
desc.targetBpm: The goal tempo you're working toward.
desc.increment: BPM added each up-step. Bigger number = faster ramp.
desc.decrement: BPM subtracted each down-step (zigzag only). Smaller than increment to crawl forward.
desc.beats: Clicks per cell. Beat 1 is always accented so you can hear the pattern.
desc.repeat: How many cells per column — the number of times you repeat at each tempo before moving on.
desc.cyclic: Climbs to the target, then comes back down to the start in the same steps, over and over.
desc.aggressiveness: How quickly the tempo changes. Conservative waits longer, Aggressive pushes faster.
desc.countdown: 4-beat countdown before the drill starts. Helps you lock into the tempo.
